acquisition_method.evidence: Data Independent Acquisition (DIA) included 20 windows with a full scan at 70,000 resolution (AGC target of 1e6 and maximum injection time of 50 ms) and 20 DIA scans at 35,000 resolution (AGC target of 1e6, maximum injection time of 120 ms and normalized collision energy of 25).

cleavage_agent.evidence: trypsin (from porcine pancreas) was added to each sample at an E/S1/50 (200 ng).

collision_energy.evidence: Data Independent Acquisition (DIA) included 20 windows with a full scan at 70,000 resolution (AGC target of 1e6 and maximum injection time of 50 ms) and 20 DIA scans at 35,000 resolution (AGC target of 1e6, maximum injection time of 120 ms and normalized collision energy of 25).

ionization_type.evidence: By applying a potential of 2000 V to the front end of the column through a tee piece, nanoelectrospray (nESI) was obtained.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: A Q-Exactive hybrid quadrupole-orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operating in positive ion mode, coupled with an Easy LC 1000 nanoscale liquid chromatography system (Thermo Fisher Scientific), was used to carry out a mass spectrometry (MS) analysis.

reduction_concentration.evidence: 3.2 µL of 100 mM Dithiothreitol (DTT, 1 h incubation at 37 °C), 3.8 µL of 200 mM iodoacetamide (1 h incubation at 37 °C), and finally 0.6 µL (1 h incubation at 37 °C) of 100 mM DTT were added sequentially.
